facts.fact: Molly 向 Jessica 解释门前多出的松木棺材是 Round Robin 的善意信号，不必害怕
facts.anchor: That’s just Round Robin giving you a little peek behind the veil, luv. It’s a good sign. It means he likes you.

facts.fact: 开门的老头衰变严重，Jessica 没认出来，直到 Molly 问候才知道是 Winston
facts.anchor: He looked like a skeleton coated in pancake batter, and he smelled like sour milk.

facts.fact: 小屋内景：蜡烛与 Hummel 瓷偶挤满每一处，空气里还有霉味，Winston 崩瘫在厨房椅上不再应答
facts.anchor: Every table, every shelf, every surface was crowded with candles and porcelain Hummel figures of doe-eyed moppets.

facts.fact: 远处房间飘来极轻的耳语让 Jessica 进去；帐幔后又说 Come closer
facts.anchor: Come in, it said, if it said anything at all.

facts.fact: Lady Tuppence 婉拒 crunkle 和 jam baps，讨一口 elk’s blood，Jessica 亲手喂她
facts.anchor: I’m past the point that crunkle can help me. But I’d give my left tit for just a finger of elk’s blood.

facts.fact: Lady Tuppence 点破：上次鹦鹉搅翻黄瓜三明治是刻意调开注意力的便利干扰
facts.anchor: Last time we spoke, deary, remember when that wretched bird of mine plowed right through the cucumber sandwiches? A convenient distraction, wasn’t it?

facts.fact: Lady Tuppence 逼问：上次你正要说一件很重要的事，现在愿意说了吗
facts.anchor: Before that, you were just about to tell me something very, very important. Are you ready to tell me now?

facts.fact: Jessica 终于开口自白：Greg 不再碰她，她认定这是对 Morgan 那段往事的惩罚，而这一切都是为了 Sandy
收尾钩子：Lady Tuppence 笑着说 Helena Hollyoak 并不古老——她本人认识 Helena
facts.anchor: She’s not so ancient as you think. Because, you see, I knew Helena Hollyoak.
